links.passage: Currently, drip fertigation (DF) is gaining importance due to its efficient utilization of nutrients and water. This method minimizes surface runoff and decreases evaporation from the ground by placing laterals below the soil at regular intervals (Mehri et al. 2023; Ogura et al. 2021).

links.passage: Drip irrigation involves the delivery of both water and fertilizer solutions in the proximity of the plant's root system using plastic tubing (Mwinuka et al. 2021; Orta et al. 2023). This method not only promotes enhanced nutrient absorption but also mitigates losses from evaporation during conveyance, seepage, and percolation (El–Metwally et al. 2022; Makhlouf et al. 2022).
